name: Model Data Generator
description: Generate synthetic datasets from configurable regression models
whenToUse: When synthetic data from a known regression model is needed — to practise DOE analysis and regression, or to test methods against a known “true” model — with factors, coefficients, noise and a seed for reproducible results.
modelDesc: Y = β₀ + Σ βᵢ·xᵢ + Σ βᵢⱼ·xᵢ·xⱼ + … + ε  (factors normalized to [0, 1])

invariants.factorRange: For every factor the lower limit (Min) must not exceed the upper limit (Max).
invariants.factorCount: The model needs at least one factor.
invariants.betaKeys: Coefficients exist only for terms of the model, and only coefficients other than 0 are stored.
